tools.name: deepinfra_get_account
tools.description: Get the current DeepInfra account / user details (identity, email, quotas). DeepInfra REST: GET /v1/me.

tools.name: deepinfra_get_rate_limit
tools.description: Get the account's current rate limits (per-model / per-endpoint request and token limits). DeepInfra REST: GET /v1/me/rate_limit.

tools.name: deepinfra_list_api_tokens
tools.description: List the account's API tokens (metadata only, not secret values). DeepInfra REST: GET /v1/api-tokens.

tools.name: deepinfra_get_usage
tools.description: Get spend / usage for a billing period. DeepInfra REST: GET /payment/usage.

tools.name: deepinfra_get_usage_tokens
tools.description: Get per-model token usage for a period. DeepInfra REST: GET /payment/usage/tokens.

tools.name: deepinfra_get_usage_rent
tools.description: Get GPU rental (dedicated hardware) usage for a time range. DeepInfra REST: GET /payment/usage/rent.

tools.name: deepinfra_list_invoices
tools.description: List billing invoices for the account. DeepInfra REST: GET /payment/invoices.

tools.name: deepinfra_list_deployments
tools.description: List the account's dedicated deployments. DeepInfra REST: GET /deploy/list.

tools.name: deepinfra_get_deployment
tools.description: Get one dedicated deployment by id (config + current status). DeepInfra REST: GET /deploy/{deploy_id}.

tools.name: deepinfra_get_deployment_stats
tools.description: Get time-series stats (throughput / latency / replicas) for a dedicated deployment. DeepInfra REST: GET /deploy/{deploy_id}/stats2.

tools.name: deepinfra_get_gpu_availability
tools.description: Get GPU availability for LLM deployments (which hardware can currently be provisioned). DeepInfra REST: GET /deploy/llm/gpu_availability.

tools.name: deepinfra_list_models
tools.description: List the DeepInfra model catalog (all available models). DeepInfra REST: GET /models/list.

tools.name: deepinfra_get_model
tools.description: Get one model's catalog entry (pricing, context length, capabilities). DeepInfra REST: GET /models/{model_name}.

tools.name: deepinfra_get_hardware
tools.description: Get the hardware options / GPU configuration available for a given model. DeepInfra REST: GET /v2/hardware.

tools.name: deepinfra_query_logs
tools.description: Query inference request logs for a dedicated deployment over a time window. DeepInfra REST: GET /v1/logs/query.

tools.name: deepinfra_get_live_metrics
tools.description: Get global live inference metrics across the account (real-time throughput / activity). DeepInfra REST: GET /v1/metrics/live.

tools.name: deepinfra_start_deployment
tools.description: Start (resume) a dedicated deployment. WARNING: this resumes a dedicated deployment and may incur GPU charges while it runs. DeepInfra REST: POST /deploy/{deploy_id}/start.

tools.name: deepinfra_stop_deployment
tools.description: Stop (pause) a running dedicated deployment. This halts inference and stops accruing GPU charges for it. DeepInfra REST: POST /deploy/{deploy_id}/stop.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "deepinfra_list_api_tokens" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: List the account's API tokens (metadata only, not secret values). DeepInfra REST: GET /v1/api-tokens.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: deepinfra_get_account · Private data: deepinfra_get_rate_limit, deepinfra_list_api_tokens, deepinfra_get_usage_tokens · Public sink: deepinfra_get_account, deepinfra_start_deployment, deepinfra_stop_deployment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: deepinfra_get_account · Private data: deepinfra_get_rate_limit, deepinfra_list_api_tokens, deepinfra_get_usage_tokens · Public sink: deepinfra_get_account, deepinfra_start_deployment, deepinfra_stop_deployment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
